svg.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: P1 arm-ratio strip plot
svg.text: P1 ECCp-131 tier 1: per-arm ratio to E0 (geometric mean over paired targets), one point per arm
Recorded values of tier1_analysis.json (masked analysis, labels mapped with the key opened after the freeze). Whiskers: ci95 field at ci_level 0.9995 (40000 resamples).
Lane order inside each panel, top to bottom: neighbour, random, isomorphic, A/A repeat, A/A permuted. Panel x range is shared per column.

Dashed line: ratio 1 (E0). Ratio = arm over E0, geometric mean over the paired (target, rep) instances; counted metrics are exact, cpu_s is a clock taken at L0 on a loaded host and is descriptive only.
Source data: p1_arm_ratio_strip.data.tsv. D_solve is the XL/Macaulay closure degree of this engine, not an F4 solving degree and not a degree of regularity.
